verdict.rationale: SigNoz keeps traces, metrics, and logs in one OpenTelemetry-native platform, with flamegraph span views and separate log and metric explorers. The only documented cross-signal navigation is drilling from a dashboard panel into its underlying logs and traces, not jumping from a span to its correlated logs and metrics. Missing for 10: documented span-to-logs navigation, span-to-metrics correlation (e.g. trace ID linking), and hands-on or independent corroboration of end-to-end request debugging across signals.
